rules: One assigned writer per checkout; the primary writer owns source removals, application composition and lockfiles.
Coordinator owns provisioning and remote settings; graph nodes do not prove that remotes exist.
Deferred TODOs are excluded from provisioning, implementation, current release manifests and migration completion.
Data-contract graph nodes are not repositories.
Conditional support changes preserve existing upstream ownership and history.
